title: Integrated skills - English for economics and business 1

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Develop academic English language skills, including vocabulary, grammar, listening, speaking, reading, and writing at the pre-intermediate level.
Gain foundational knowledge in economics and business topics such as organizational structures, advertising, finance, and marketing.
Enhance communication skills necessary for business environments, including negotiation, discussion, presentation, and email writing.
Apply critical thinking to solve communication tasks and analyze business scenarios.
Work effectively in groups to solve problems and conduct research.
Demonstrate professional communication skills in business contexts, including email and report writing.
Prepare and deliver presentations on business topics.
Understand and respond to business-related dialogues and interviews.
Read and comprehend business articles, reports, and other texts.
Write emails, business letters, and reports on various topics.
